import BusyBeaver.ZFC.Rotation244Pulse
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterMarkPerm252

/-!
Fresh Rotation244 port of Routing245Boxes.
Only machine/state/module identities and the explicit selector literals change.
All-register, complete-tape and positive-clock hypotheses are retained.
The original Mira-Cult/Jeff Ketchersid/Andrew James Wade and ProveIt lineage
remains attributed. This source is uncompiled at emission; coverage, exact
blank initialization and the final Combined243 calibration remain separate.
-/
namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Rotation244Boxes

open FiniteZipper ZipperRuns RegisterBoxesPerm252

abbrev carry : Fin 244 := oldStateRotation244 95
abbrev carryProbe : Fin 244 := oldStateRotation244 109
abbrev test : Fin 244 := oldStateRotation244 75
abbrev seek : Fin 244 := oldStateRotation244 73
abbrev seekProbe : Fin 244 := oldStateRotation244 83
abbrev returnOnes : Fin 244 := oldStateRotation244 63
abbrev returnZero : Fin 244 := oldStateRotation244 48
abbrev rollback : Fin 244 := oldStateRotation244 112
abbrev rollbackProbe : Fin 244 := oldStateRotation244 131

/-- An ordinary block 01^(v+1) after the forward carry has crossed it. -/
def carryBits : List Nat → List Bool
  | [] => []
  | v :: vs => true :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ carryBits vs)

/-- The same crossed blocks in nearest-first order on the left half-tape. -/
def carryLeft : List Nat → List Bool
  | [] => []
  | v :: vs => List.replicate v true ++ false :: true :: carryLeft vs

private theorem ones_snoc (v : Nat) (l : List Bool) :
    List.replicate v true ++ true :: l = true :: (List.replicate v true ++ l) := by
  calc
    _ = (List.replicate v true ++ [true]) ++ l := (List.append_assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [← List.replicate_succ', List.replicate_succ]; rfl

theorem carryBits_append (a b : List Nat) :
    carryBits (a ++ b) = carryBits a ++ carryBits b := by
  induction a with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons v a ih => simp [carryBits, ih]

theorem carryLeft_append (a b : List Nat) :
    carryLeft (a ++ b) = carryLeft a ++ carryLeft b := by
  induction a with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons v a ih => simp [carryLeft, ih, List.append_assoc]

theorem reverse_carryBits (vs : List Nat) :
    (carryBits vs).reverse = carryLeft vs.reverse := by
  induction vs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons v vs ih =>
    simp [carryBits, List.reverse_append, ih, carryLeft_append, carryLeft,
      List.append_assoc]

/-- The last carried one turns the crossed prefix into a one-cell right shift. -/
theorem carryBits_snoc (pre : List Nat) (X : List Bool) :
    carryBits pre ++ true :: X = true :: (registerBits pre ++ X) := by
  induction pre with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons v pre ih =>
    simp only [carryBits, registerBits, List.cons_append, List.append_assoc]
    rw [ih, ones_snoc]

private theorem reverse_carry_snoc (pre : List Nat) (l : List Bool) :
    true :: ((carryBits pre).reverse ++ l) =
      (registerBits pre).reverse ++ true :: l := by
  have hr := congrArg List.reverse (carryBits_snoc pre [])
  simp only [List.append_nil, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_cons,
    List.reverse_nil, List.nil_append, List.singleton_append] at hr
  calc
    _ = (true :: (carryBits pre).reverse) ++ l := rfl
    _ = ((registerBits pre).reverse ++ [true]) ++ l := congrArg (fun t => t ++ l) hr
    _ = _ := by simp only [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]

/-- Forward carry crosses a separator, replacing01 by10. -/
theorem carry_separator (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244 (zAt carry h l (false :: true :: X)) 2 =
      zAt carry (h + 2) (false :: true :: l) X := by
  rw [zipRun_first, step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old95_false,
    zipRun_first, step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old109_true]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

theorem carry_block (v : Nat) (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244
      (zAt carry h l (false :: true :: (List.replicate v true ++ X))) (v + 2) =
      zAt carry (h + ((v + 2 : Nat) : Int))
        (List.replicate v true ++ false :: true :: l) X := by
  rw [show v + 2 = 2 + v by omega, zipRun_add, carry_separator,
    scan_right _ _ _ rowRotation244_old95_true]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- This induction is over all prefix lengths and all unary block values. -/
theorem carry_file (pre : List Nat) (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244 (zAt carry h l (registerBits pre ++ X)) (width pre) =
      zAt carry (h + (width pre : Int)) ((carryBits pre).reverse ++ l) X := by
  induction pre generalizing h l with
  | nil => simp [registerBits, carryBits, width, zipRun]
  | cons v pre ih =>
    simp only [width, registerBits, List.cons_append, List.append_assoc]
    rw [zipRun_add, carry_block, ih]
    simp only [carryBits, List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_replicate,
      List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]
    congr 1
    omega

/-- Two forward steps arrive at the test cell after the marked00. -/
theorem carry_mark (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244 (zAt carry h l (false :: false :: X)) 2 =
      zAt test (h + 2) (false :: true :: l) X := by
  rw [zipRun_first, step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old95_false,
    zipRun_first, step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old109_false]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- The existing return scanner instantiated on three literal244 rows. -/
theorem return_separator (pre : List Nat) (h : Int) (l Y : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244
      (zAt returnOnes h ((registerBits pre).reverse ++ l) (false :: Y))
      (width pre + 1) =
      leftAt returnZero (h - (width pre : Int)) l (registerBits pre ++ false :: Y) := by
  simpa only [reverse_registerBits, width_reverse, List.reverse_reverse] using
    RegisterMarkPerm252.return_separator_left machineRotation244 returnOnes returnZero
      rowRotation244_old63_true rowRotation244_old63_false rowRotation244_old48_true
      pre.reverse h l Y

/-- A positive selected value v+1 is decreased to v. The boundary moves right one cell;
the final head is at the old origin, which now contains the added left one. -/
theorem positive_decrement_zip (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat)
    (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244
      (zAt carry h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate (v + 1) true ++ registerBits rest)))
      (2 * width pre + 4) =
      zAt returnZero h l (true :: registerBits (pre ++ v :: rest)) := by
  rw [show 2 * width pre + 4 = width pre + (2 + ((width pre + 1) + 1)) by omega,
    zipRun_add, carry_file, zipRun_add, carry_mark]
  rw [reverse_carry_snoc]
  simp only [List.replicate_succ, List.cons_append]
  rw [zipRun_first, step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old75_true,
    leftAt_cons, return_separator, leftAt_cons]
  simp only [registerBits_append, registerBits]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- The reverse carry changes a crossed 10 pair back to 01. -/
theorem rollback_pair (h : Int) (l Y : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244 (leftAt rollback h (false :: true :: l) Y) 2 =
      leftAt rollback (h - 2) l (false :: true :: Y) := by
  rw [leftAt_cons, zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old112_false,
    leftAt_cons, zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old131_true]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- Restore every crossed block, starting with the nearest block. -/
theorem rollback_left (rp : List Nat) (h : Int) (l Y : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244 (leftAt rollback h (carryLeft rp ++ l) Y) (width rp) =
      leftAt rollback (h - (width rp : Int)) l (registerBits rp.reverse ++ Y) := by
  induction rp generalizing h Y with
  | nil => simp [width, carryLeft, registerBits, zipRun]
  | cons v rp ih =>
    simp only [width, carryLeft, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append]
    rw [show v + 2 + width rp = v + (2 + width rp) by omega,
      zipRun_add, scan_left _ _ _ rowRotation244_old112_true,
      zipRun_add, rollback_pair, ih]
    simp only [List.reverse_cons, registerBits_append, registerBits,
      List.append_nil, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append]
    congr 1
    omega

theorem rollback_file (pre : List Nat) (h : Int) (l Y : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244
      (leftAt rollback h ((carryBits pre).reverse ++ l) Y) (width pre) =
      leftAt rollback (h - (width pre : Int)) l (registerBits pre ++ Y) := by
  simpa only [reverse_carryBits, width_reverse, List.reverse_reverse] using
    rollback_left pre.reverse h l Y

/-- On a marked zero followed by an ordinary block, restore the selected 01
and prepare the backwards restoration of the preceding crossed prefix. -/
theorem zero_restore (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244
      (zAt test h (false :: true :: l) (false :: true :: X)) 5 =
      leftAt rollback (h - 2) l (false :: true :: false :: true :: X) := by
  rw [show 5 = 3 + 2 by decide, zipRun_add, Rotation244Pulse.pulse_zero_one,
    leftAt_cons, zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old112_false,
    leftAt_cons, zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old131_true]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- A zero selected register is restored, with output state112 rather than
old 3. The explicit first following block is essential for the zero test. -/
theorem zero_decrement_zip (pre : List Nat) (next : Nat) (rest : List Nat)
    (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244
      (zAt carry h l (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: registerBits (next :: rest)))
      (2 * width pre + 7) =
      leftAt rollback h l (registerBits (pre ++ 0 :: next :: rest)) := by
  rw [show 2 * width pre + 7 = width pre + (2 + (5 + width pre)) by omega,
    zipRun_add, carry_file, zipRun_add, carry_mark]
  simp only [registerBits]
  rw [zipRun_add, zero_restore, rollback_file]
  simp only [registerBits_append, registerBits, List.replicate_zero,
    List.nil_append]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- The increment seeker passes an ordinary block unchanged. -/
theorem seek_block (v : Nat) (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244
      (zAt seek h l (false :: true :: (List.replicate v true ++ X))) (v + 2) =
      zAt seek (h + ((v + 2 : Nat) : Int))
        (List.replicate v true ++ true :: false :: l) X := by
  rw [show v + 2 = (v + 1) + 1 by omega, zipRun_first,
    step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old73_false, zipRun_first,
    step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old83_true,
    scan_right _ _ _ rowRotation244_old73_true]
  congr 1
  omega

theorem seek_file (pre : List Nat) (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244 (zAt seek h l (registerBits pre ++ X)) (width pre) =
      zAt seek (h + (width pre : Int)) ((registerBits pre).reverse ++ l) X := by
  induction pre generalizing h l with
  | nil => simp [registerBits, width, zipRun]
  | cons v pre ih =>
    simp only [width, registerBits, List.cons_append, List.append_assoc]
    rw [zipRun_add, seek_block, ih]
    simp only [List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_replicate,
      List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]
    congr 1
    omega

theorem restore_mark (v : Nat) (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244
      (zAt seek h l (false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ X))) 2 =
      zAt carry (h + 2) (true :: false :: l) (List.replicate v true ++ X) := by
  rw [zipRun_first, step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old73_false,
    zipRun_first, step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old83_false]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

private theorem step_right_blank (q q' : Fin 244) (written : Bool)
    (h : Int) (l : List Bool)
    (ht : machineRotation244.transition q false = ⟨written, .right, some q'⟩) :
    zipStep machineRotation244 (zAt q h l []) =
      zAt q' (h + 1) (written :: l) [] := by
  simp [zipStep, zAt, ht, zipWrite, zipRight]

private theorem step_left_blank (q q' : Fin 244) (written : Bool)
    (h : Int) (l : List Bool)
    (ht : machineRotation244.transition q false = ⟨written, .left, some q'⟩) :
    zipStep machineRotation244 (zAt q h l []) = leftAt q' h l [written] := by
  simp [zipStep, zAt, leftAt, ht, zipWrite, zipLeft]

/-- The same zero/zero pulse at the finite representation's blank exterior.
Both previously implicit cells become explicit because they are written. -/
private theorem pulse_blank (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244 (zAt test h l []) 3 =
      leftAt rollbackProbe h l [true, true] := by
  rw [zipRun_first, step_right_blank _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old75_false,
    zipRun_first, step_left_blank _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old255_false,
    leftAt_cons, zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old255_true]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- Reaching the file's blank end appends 011 and turns left. -/
theorem carry_end (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244 (zAt carry h l []) 6 =
      leftAt returnZero (h + 1) (true :: l) [false, true, true] := by
  rw [zipRun_first, step_right_blank _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old95_false,
    zipRun_first, step_right_blank _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old109_false,
    show 4 = 3 + 1 by decide, zipRun_add, pulse_blank, leftAt_cons, zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old131_false]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- Carry through every following register and spare. Only the zero exterior
is special; all existing suffix values are arbitrary natural numbers. -/
theorem shift_suffix (rest : List Nat) (a : Nat) (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244
      (zAt carry h l (List.replicate a true ++ registerBits rest))
      (a + width rest + 6) =
      leftAt returnZero (h + ((a + width rest + 1 : Nat) : Int))
        ((List.replicate (a + 1) true ++ registerBits rest).reverse ++ l)
        [false, true, true] := by
  induction rest generalizing a h l with
  | nil =>
    simp only [width, registerBits, Nat.add_zero]
    rw [zipRun_add _ _ a 6, scan_right _ _ _ rowRotation244_old95_true, carry_end]
    rw [List.append_nil, List.reverse_replicate, List.replicate_succ]
    congr 1
    omega
  | cons v rest ih =>
    simp only [width, registerBits]
    rw [show a + (v + 2 + width rest) + 6 = a + (2 + (v + width rest + 6)) by omega,
      zipRun_add, scan_right _ _ _ rowRotation244_old95_true,
      zipRun_add, carry_separator, ih]
    simp only [List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_replicate,
      List.singleton_append, List.append_assoc, List.replicate_succ]
    simp only [ones_snoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
    congr 1
    omega

/-- The complete increment excursion. Exactly one value-one spare is appended;
all prior suffix registers and all exterior cells are retained. -/
theorem increment_zip (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat)
    (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244
      (zAt seek h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ registerBits rest)))
      (2 * width (pre ++ v :: rest) + 7) =
      leftAt returnZero h l (registerBits ((pre ++ (v + 1) :: rest) ++ [1])) := by
  have hne : pre ++ (v + 1) :: rest ≠ [] := by simp
  have firstCount : 2 * width (pre ++ v :: rest) + 7 =
      width pre + (2 + ((v + width rest + 6) + width (pre ++ (v + 1) :: rest))) := by
    simp only [width_append, width]
    omega
  rw [firstCount, zipRun_add, seek_file, zipRun_add]
  simp only [List.append_assoc]
  rw [restore_mark, zipRun_add, shift_suffix]
  have frame :
      (List.replicate (v + 1) true ++ registerBits rest).reverse ++
        true :: false :: ((registerBits pre).reverse ++ l) =
      (registerBits (pre ++ (v + 1) :: rest)).reverse ++ l := by
    simp only [registerBits_append, registerBits, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_cons,
      List.reverse_replicate, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
  rw [frame, RegisterMarkPerm252.return_end machineRotation244 returnOnes returnZero
    rowRotation244_old63_true rowRotation244_old63_false rowRotation244_old48_true
    _ hne returnZero rowRotation244_old48_true]
  simp only [registerBits_append, registerBits, List.replicate_succ,
    List.replicate_zero, List.append_nil, List.append_assoc]
  congr 1
  simp only [width_append, width]
  omega

/-- The same positive endpoint in boundary notation: the file origin moves
right by one and the arbitrary old left context gains exactly one one-cell. -/
theorem positive_decrement_boundary (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat)
    (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244
      (zAt carry h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate (v + 1) true ++ registerBits rest)))
      (2 * width pre + 4) =
      leftAt returnZero (h + 1) (true :: l) (registerBits (pre ++ v :: rest)) := by
  rw [positive_decrement_zip, leftAt_cons]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- Whole-tape Core contract for positive decrement, with exact duration. -/
theorem positive_decrement {c : Config 244} (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat)
    (rest : List Nat) (h : Int) (l : List Bool)
    (hc : ZipRep c (zAt carry h l
      (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate (v + 1) true ++ registerBits rest)))) :
    ZipRep (machineRotation244.runFrom c (2 * width pre + 4))
      (zAt returnZero h l (true :: registerBits (pre ++ v :: rest))) := by
  have hs := zipRun_sound machineRotation244 (2 * width pre + 4) hc
  rw [positive_decrement_zip] at hs
  exact hs

/-- Whole-tape Core contract for zero decrement. The following block can have
any value; its existence is the strengthened runtime invariant's premise. -/
theorem zero_decrement {c : Config 244} (pre : List Nat) (next : Nat)
    (rest : List Nat) (h : Int) (l : List Bool)
    (hc : ZipRep c
      (zAt carry h l (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: registerBits (next :: rest)))) :
    ZipRep (machineRotation244.runFrom c (2 * width pre + 7))
      (leftAt rollback h l (registerBits (pre ++ 0 :: next :: rest))) := by
  have hs := zipRun_sound machineRotation244 (2 * width pre + 7) hc
  rw [zero_decrement_zip] at hs
  exact hs

/-- Whole-tape Core contract for increment and its new spare block. -/
theorem increment {c : Config 244} (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat)
    (rest : List Nat) (h : Int) (l : List Bool)
    (hc : ZipRep c (zAt seek h l
      (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ registerBits rest)))) :
    ZipRep (machineRotation244.runFrom c (2 * width (pre ++ v :: rest) + 7))
      (leftAt returnZero h l (registerBits ((pre ++ (v + 1) :: rest) ++ [1]))) := by
  have hs := zipRun_sound machineRotation244 (2 * width (pre ++ v :: rest) + 7) hc
  rw [increment_zip] at hs
  exact hs

/-- A selected index below 9 in a file with at least 10 blocks has a following
block. No bound is placed on its value or on the length of the suffix. -/
theorem following_nonempty (pre rest : List Nat) (v : Nat)
    (hp : pre.length < 9) (hf : 10 ≤ (pre ++ v :: rest).length) : rest ≠ [] := by
  intro he
  subst rest
  simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hf
  omega

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Rotation244Boxes

# Sequential fresh runtime checks

The frozen `check_runtime.py` runs exactly one unit and focused audit. It is not a source emitter or a multi-compiler coordinator. Root owns each invocation. Its manifest pins all eight source/audit identities, probe/caller counts, exact import closures, fixed actual evidence anchors and allowed dependency names. No future object hashes are invented or selected in the manifest.

| Unit | Projects | Probes / callers | Required `--parent` values |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| pulse | 5 | 3 / 4 | none; actual KernelRows is fixed |
| mark | 7 | 10 / 6 | none; actual TableRotation244 is fixed |
| boxes | 9 | 14 / 19 | pulse |
| symbolic | 13 | 15 / 15 | boxes, mark; actual FastTableRotation244 is fixed |
| site | 18 | 12 / 13 | symbolic |
| frame | 22 | 14 / 15 | site |
| instruction | 23 | 7 / 7 | frame |

Each parent argument consists of three separate values: `--parent UNIT RECORD SHA256`. Only the exact named predecessor set is accepted. A parent must be a successful actual source/audit record for the expected module, source bytes, audit bytes and census. The guard checks zero warnings, standard axiom reports, unchanged default limits, all current before/after inputs, original/snapshot bytes, raw source/audit logs, fresh-source capture before audit and its first-provider identity. Its successful parent object and reused providers then enter an independently recomputed import DFS. No failed, merely prepared, wrong-source or guessed future module can enter the cache.

The fixed generic anchor is the checked RuntimeInstanceRouting245 record. Only unchanged generic modules needed by the new import DFS can be selected from it; old Routing245 machine-specific objects are excluded. That record's legacy warning dictionary, sibling log locations and budget fields are handled explicitly. The current KernelRows/TableRotation/FastTable records and all newly produced runtime records use the modern schema. Every immediate parent's current input set is rehashed, but historical ancestor proofs are not re-executed.

The source/audit process runner is byte-identical to the reviewed KernelRows runner. Each pair shares120seconds with `-j1 -M4096`, no global proof-limit overrides, no version query/download/build, a fresh target object and pre-audit capture, and final input/provider/object checks. """Root-owned serial driver of the reviewed per-unit guard; stop at any failure."""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib
ROOT=Path('/tmp/zfc-rotation244-runtime-ports-v1')
CONTROL=ROOT/'control'
GUARD=CONTROL/'check_runtime.py'
MANIFEST=CONTROL/'runtime-manifest.json'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha(GUARD)=='0c9cc3527dc255c8e23ffc543067e230c05365007dcda71266fa0f3daba28ee8'
assert sha(MANIFEST)=='28c577e87e4c51d5740cfea2720c8a2ea41ff6777bc73eabca14bf955cdff438'
m=json.loads(MANIFEST.read_text()); log=CONTROL/'root-execution';log.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
results=[]
for name in ['mark','boxes','symbolic','site','frame','instruction','runtime']:
 u=m['units'][name];args=['python3','-B',str(GUARD),'--unit',name]
 for parent in u['future_parents']:
  record=ROOT/parent/'run1/verification.json';d=json.loads(record.read_text())
  assert d['status']=='PASS' and d['warnings']==0
  args+=['--parent',parent,str(record),sha(record)]
 for phase in ['prepared1','run1']:
  dest=ROOT/name/phase;assert not dest.exists(),dest
  cmd=args+(['--prepare-only'] if phase=='prepared1' else [])+['--output',str(dest)]
  r=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True)
  (log/(name+'-'+phase+'.log')).write_text(r.stdout)
  assert r.returncode==0,(name,phase,r.stdout)
  actual=dest/'verification.json';data=json.loads(actual.read_text())
  assert data['status']==('PREPARED_NOT_BUILT' if phase=='prepared1' else 'PASS')
  if phase=='run1':
   assert data['warnings']==0
   summary=dict(unit=name,record=str(actual),sha256=sha(actual),probes=data['named_axiom_probes'],callers=data['callers'],warnings=data['warnings'],seconds=sum(c['seconds']for c in data['commands']))
   results.append(summary);(log/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
   print(json.dumps(summary),flush=True)
print('ALL_SEVEN_PASS',flush=True)

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterPathClean
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.SiteRotation244

/-!
Fresh Rotation244 port of Routing245Simulation.
Only machine/state/module identities and the explicit selector literals change.
All-register, complete-tape and positive-clock hypotheses are retained.
The original Mira-Cult/Jeff Ketchersid/Andrew James Wade and ProveIt lineage
remains attributed. This source is uncompiled at emission; coverage, exact
blank initialization and the final Combined243 calibration remain separate.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Rotation244Simulation

open RegisterPath FiniteZipper Permutation252Frame SymbolicRotation244

/-- The routing decoder's whole-tape dispatch frame. Its margin is 64,
while padding, all register values and the complete spare suffix remain free. -/
def DispatchFrame64 {states : Nat} (dispatch : Fin states) (binary : Config states)
    (logical : Configuration) (gap : Nat) (spares : List Nat) : Prop :=
  64 ≤ logical.path.length + gap ∧ LogicalTailZero logical.registers ∧
    ∃ leftPadding rightPadding : Nat,
      ZipRep binary (dispatchZip dispatch binary.head leftPadding rightPadding logical gap spares)

theorem registerBits_eq (vs : List Nat) :
    RegisterBoxesPerm252.registerBits vs = Permutation252Frame.registerBits vs := by
  induction vs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons v vs ih =>
    change false :: true :: (List.replicate v true ++ RegisterBoxesPerm252.registerBits vs) =
      false :: true :: (List.replicate v true ++ Permutation252Frame.registerBits vs)
    rw [ih]

theorem flat_map_bit (n : Nat) (vs : List Nat) (P : List Bool) :
    flat n vs (P.map Segment.bit) = P := by
  induction P with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b P ih => simpa only [List.map_cons, flat_cons, segmentBits,
      List.singleton_append] using congrArg (List.cons b) ih

theorem start_concrete (n : Nat) (vs : List Nat) (Q : List Bool) (h : Int) :
    concrete n vs (SiteRotation244.start Q) h =
      zAtS (some SiteRotation244.dispatch) h [true]
        (Q ++ List.replicate (n + (64 - Q.length)) false ++ [true] ++
          Permutation252Frame.registerBits vs) := by
  simp only [concrete, SiteRotation244.start, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
  rw [flat_append, flat_map_bit]
  simp [SiteRotation244.minDistance, flat, segmentBits, boxBits, registerBits_eq,
    zAtS, List.append_assoc]

private theorem strip_padding {binary : Config 244} (q : Option (Fin 244))
    (h : Int) (l r : List Bool) (leftPadding rightPadding : Nat)
    (hz : ZipRep binary (zAtS q h (l ++ List.replicate leftPadding false)
      (r ++ List.replicate rightPadding false))) :
    ZipRep binary (zAtS q h l r) := by
  apply zipRep_at_congr q h _ _ _ _ _ _ hz
  · intro i
    exact getD_append_padding l leftPadding i
  · intro i
    exact getD_append_padding r rightPadding i

/-- The stored path may be shorter than the consumed prefix. The missing
bits are taken from its existing zero gap, preserving the complete tape. -/
theorem source_represents (logical : Configuration) (binary : Config 244)
    (gap : Nat) (spares : List Nat) (Q : List Bool)
    (hf : DispatchFrame64 SiteRotation244.dispatch binary logical gap spares)
    (hq : Q = consume logical.path Q.length)
    (hz : ∀ b ∈ logical.path.drop Q.length, b = false)
    (hd : Q.length ≤ 64) :
    Represents (logical.path.length + gap - 64)
      (vregs logical.registers ++ spares) (SiteRotation244.start Q) binary := by
  rcases hf with ⟨hbudget, htail, leftPadding, rightPadding, hf⟩
  have hpc : logical.path ++ List.replicate gap false =
      Q ++ List.replicate ((logical.path.length + gap - 64) +
        (64 - Q.length)) false := by
    have he := RegisterPathClean.gap_consume logical.path gap Q.length (by omega) hz
    rw [← hq] at he
    rw [he]
    congr 2
    omega
  refine ⟨binary.head, ?_⟩
  rw [start_concrete]
  apply strip_padding _ _ [true]
    (Q ++ List.replicate ((logical.path.length + gap - 64) +
      (64 - Q.length)) false ++ [true] ++
      Permutation252Frame.registerBits (vregs logical.registers ++ spares))
    leftPadding rightPadding
  simpa only [dispatchZip, hpc, zAtS, List.singleton_append,
    List.append_assoc] using hf

theorem target_concrete (n : Nat) (vs : List Nat) (P : List Bool)
    (overflow : Bool) (extra : Nat) (x : Box) (h : Int) :
    concrete n vs (SiteRotation244.target P overflow extra x) h =
      zAtS (some SiteRotation244.dispatch) h [true]
        (P ++ List.replicate (n + (64 + (if overflow then 1 else 0) + extra - P.length)) false ++
          [true] ++ boxBits x vs) := by
  simp only [concrete, SiteRotation244.target, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
  rw [flat_append, flat_map_bit]
  simp [SiteRotation244.minDistance, flat, segmentBits, zAtS, List.append_assoc]

/-- Rebase a checked symbolic target at the updated logical register file.
The box equality states its entire physical file, including the spare tail. -/
theorem target_frame (n : Nat) (vs : List Nat) (P : List Bool)
    (overflow : Bool) (extra : Nat) (x : Box) (R' : Registers) (spares' : List Nat)
    (binary : Config 244)
    (hlen : P.length ≤ 64 + (if overflow then 1 else 0) + extra)
    (htail : LogicalTailZero R')
    (hbox : boxBits x vs =
      Permutation252Frame.registerBits (vregs R' ++ spares'))
    (hr : Represents n vs (SiteRotation244.target P overflow extra x) binary) :
    DispatchFrame64 SiteRotation244.dispatch binary ⟨P, R'⟩
      (n + (64 + (if overflow then 1 else 0) + extra - P.length)) spares' := by
  obtain ⟨h, hr⟩ := hr
  rw [target_concrete, hbox] at hr
  have hh : binary.head = h := hr.2.1
  refine ⟨by dsimp; omega, htail, 0, 0, ?_⟩
  simpa only [dispatchZip, zAtS, hh, List.replicate_zero,
    List.append_nil, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.append_assoc] using hr

theorem incr_eq_write (vs : List Nat) (r : Nat) (hr : r < vs.length) :
    incr r vs = writeRegisters vs r (vs.getD r 0 + 1) := by
  induction r generalizing vs with
  | zero => cases vs <;> simp_all [incr, writeRegisters]
  | succ r ih =>
    cases vs with
    | nil => simp at hr
    | cons v vs =>
      change v :: incr r vs = v :: writeRegisters vs r (vs.getD r 0 + 1)
      rw [ih vs (by simpa using hr)]

theorem decr_eq_write (vs : List Nat) (r : Nat) (hr : r < vs.length) :
    decr r vs = writeRegisters vs r ((vs.getD r 0).pred) := by
  induction r generalizing vs with
  | zero => cases vs <;> simp_all [decr, writeRegisters]
  | succ r ih =>
    cases vs with
    | nil => simp at hr
    | cons v vs =>
      change v :: decr r vs = v :: writeRegisters vs r ((vs.getD r 0).pred)
      rw [ih vs (by simpa using hr)]

theorem unchanged_rebase (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) :
    boxBits (.plain .unchanged) (vregs R ++ spares) =
      Permutation252Frame.registerBits (vregs R ++ spares) := by
  simp only [boxBits, registerBits_eq]

theorem nth_vregs_append_getD (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9) :
    (vregs R ++ spares).getD (physOf r) 0 = R r := by
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
  exact nth_vregs_append R spares r hr

theorem increment_rebase (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9) :
    boxBits (.plain (.increment (SiteRotation244.physical r hr))) (vregs R ++ spares) =
      Permutation252Frame.registerBits (vregs (update R r (R r + 1)) ++ (spares ++ [1])) := by
  have hp := physOf_lt (⟨r, hr⟩ : Fin 9)
  change physOf r < 9 at hp
  change RegisterBoxesPerm252.registerBits (incr (physOf r) (vregs R ++ spares) ++ [1]) = _
  rw [incr_eq_write _ _ (by simp only [List.length_append, vregs_length]; omega),
    nth_vregs_append_getD R spares r hr, update_vregs_append R spares r (R r + 1) hr,
    List.append_assoc, registerBits_eq]

theorem decrement_rebase (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9) :
    boxBits (.plain (.decrement (SiteRotation244.physical r hr))) (vregs R ++ spares) =
      Permutation252Frame.registerBits
        (vregs (update R r (R r - 1)) ++ spares) := by
  have hp := physOf_lt (⟨r, hr⟩ : Fin 9)
  change physOf r < 9 at hp
  change RegisterBoxesPerm252.registerBits (decr (physOf r) (vregs R ++ spares)) = _
  rw [decr_eq_write _ _ (by simp only [List.length_append, vregs_length]; omega),
    nth_vregs_append_getD R spares r hr, update_vregs_append R spares r (R r).pred hr]
  simp only [Nat.pred_eq_sub_one, registerBits_eq]

theorem valid_none (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) (hspares : spares ≠ []) :
    Valid none (vregs R ++ spares) := by
  refine ⟨?_, trivial⟩
  cases spares with
  | nil => exact False.elim (hspares rfl)
  | cons v rest => simp only [List.length_append, vregs_length, List.length_cons]; omega

theorem valid_branch (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat) (hspares : spares ≠ [])
    (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9)
    (zero : Bool) (hz : if zero then R r = 0 else R r ≠ 0) :
    Valid (some (SiteRotation244.physical r hr, zero)) (vregs R ++ spares) := by
  refine ⟨(valid_none R spares hspares).1, ?_⟩
  simpa only [SiteRotation244.physical, nth_vregs_append_getD R spares r hr] using hz

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Rotation244Simulation

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.Rotation244Simulation

/-!
Fresh Rotation244 port of InstructionRouting245.
Only machine/state/module identities and the explicit selector literals change.
All-register, complete-tape and positive-clock hypotheses are retained.
The original Mira-Cult/Jeff Ketchersid/Andrew James Wade and ProveIt lineage
remains attributed. This source is uncompiled at emission; coverage, exact
blank initialization and the final Combined243 calibration remain separate.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.InstructionRotation244

open RegisterPath Permutation252Frame SymbolicRotation244
open SiteRotation244 Rotation244Simulation

theorem incRev_length (P : List Bool) : (incRev P).length = P.length := by
  induction P with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b P ih => cases b <;> simp [incRev, ih]

theorem incPath_length (P : List Bool) : (incPath P).length = P.length := by
  simp only [incPath, List.length_reverse, incRev_length]

theorem stripPath_length (b : Bool) (k : Nat) (P : List Bool) :
    (stripPath b k P).length ≤ P.length := by
  obtain ⟨T, ht⟩ := RegisterPathClean.stripPath_prefix b k P
  have hl := congrArg List.length ht
  simp only [List.length_append] at hl
  omega

theorem breakPath_length (k : Nat) (P : List Bool) :
    (breakPath k P).length ≤ P.length := by
  simpa only [breakPath, incPath_length] using stripPath_length false k P

theorem continuePath_length (k : Nat) (P : List Bool) :
    (continuePath k P).length ≤ P.length := stripPath_length true k P

/-- Every accepted nonhalting site updates the complete dispatch frame.
The spare suffix stays nonempty. Increment appends one value-one block;
positive decrement preserves the suffix and adds one gap cell. -/
theorem execute_frame (Q : List Bool) (e : Edge) (R : Registers)
    (spares : List Nat) (n : Nat) (binary : Config 244) (next : Configuration)
    (hcheck : checkSite Q e = true) (htail : LogicalTailZero R)
    (hspares : spares ≠ [])
    (hc : Represents n (vregs R ++ spares) (start Q) binary)
    (he : execute e Q R = some next) :
    ∃ k : Nat, 0 < k ∧ ∃ gap spares', spares' ≠ [] ∧
      DispatchFrame64 dispatch (machineRotation244.runFrom binary k) next gap spares' := by
  have hlen : Q.length ≤ 64 := checkSite_length Q e hcheck
  cases e with
  | node r => simp only [execute, reduceCtorEq] at he
  | halt => simp only [execute, reduceCtorEq] at he
  | inc r =>
    have hr := check_inc_bound Q r hcheck
    simp only [execute, Option.some.injEq] at he
    subst next
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hs⟩ := runTo_sound none Q _ (check_inc Q r hr hcheck)
      n _ (valid_none R spares hspares) binary hc
    refine ⟨k, hk, n + (64 + (if allOnes Q then 1 else 0) - (incPath Q).length), spares ++ [1], by simp, ?_⟩
    exact target_frame n _ (incPath Q) (allOnes Q) 0 _
      (update R r (R r + 1)) (spares ++ [1]) _
      (by rw [incPath_length]; omega) (tail_update R r _ hr htail)
      (increment_rebase R spares r hr) hs
  | decnz r =>
    have hr := check_decnz_bound Q r hcheck
    obtain ⟨hzero, hpositive⟩ := check_decnz Q r hr hcheck
    cases hv : R r with
    | zero =>
      simp only [execute, hv, Option.some.injEq] at he
      subst next
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hs⟩ := runTo_sound _ Q _ hzero n _
        (valid_branch R spares hspares r hr true hv) binary hc
      refine ⟨k, hk, n + (64 + (if allOnes (stripPath false 1 Q) then 1 else 0) -
        (breakPath 1 Q).length), spares, hspares, ?_⟩
      exact target_frame n _ (breakPath 1 Q) (allOnes (stripPath false 1 Q)) 0 _
        R spares _ (by have := breakPath_length 1 Q; omega) htail
        (unchanged_rebase R spares) hs
    | succ v =>
      simp only [execute, hv, Option.some.injEq] at he
      subst next
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hs⟩ := runTo_sound _ Q _ hpositive n _
        (valid_branch R spares hspares r hr false (by simp [hv])) binary hc
      refine ⟨k, hk, n + (64 + (if allOnes Q then 1 else 0) + 1 - (incPath Q).length),
        spares, hspares, ?_⟩
      have hb := decrement_rebase R spares r hr
      simp only [hv, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hb
      exact target_frame n _ (incPath Q) (allOnes Q) 1 _ (update R r v)
        spares _ (by rw [incPath_length]; omega)
        (tail_update R r _ hr htail) hb hs
  | brk k =>
    simp only [execute, Option.some.injEq] at he
    subst next
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hs⟩ := runTo_sound none Q _ (check_break Q k hcheck)
      n _ (valid_none R spares hspares) binary hc
    refine ⟨t, ht, n + (64 + (if allOnes (stripPath false k Q) then 1 else 0) -
      (breakPath k Q).length), spares, hspares, ?_⟩
    exact target_frame n _ (breakPath k Q) (allOnes (stripPath false k Q)) 0 _
      R spares _ (by have := breakPath_length k Q; omega) htail
      (unchanged_rebase R spares) hs
  | cont k =>
    simp only [execute, Option.some.injEq] at he
    subst next
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hs⟩ := runTo_sound none Q _ (check_continue Q k hcheck)
      n _ (valid_none R spares hspares) binary hc
    refine ⟨t, ht, n + (64 - (continuePath k Q).length), spares, hspares, ?_⟩
    exact target_frame n _ (continuePath k Q) false 0 _ R spares _
      (by have := continuePath_length k Q; simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]; omega)
      htail (unchanged_rebase R spares) hs

theorem halt_frame (Q : List Bool) (R : Registers) (spares : List Nat)
    (n : Nat) (binary : Config 244) (hcheck : checkSite Q .halt = true)
    (hspares : spares ≠ [])
    (hc : Represents n (vregs R ++ spares) (start Q) binary) :
    ∃ k : Nat, 0 < k ∧ (machineRotation244.runFrom binary k).state = none :=
  runHalt_sound Q (check_halt Q hcheck) n _ (valid_none R spares hspares).1 binary hc

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.InstructionRotation244

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.TableRotation244
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterMarkPerm252

/-!
Fresh Rotation244 port of RegisterMarkRouting245.
Only machine/state/module identities and the explicit selector literals change.
All-register, complete-tape and positive-clock hypotheses are retained.
The original Mira-Cult/Jeff Ketchersid/Andrew James Wade and ProveIt lineage
remains attributed. This source is uncompiled at emission; coverage, exact
blank initialization and the final Combined243 calibration remain separate.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterMarkRotation244

open FiniteZipper ZipperRuns RegisterBoxesPerm252

/-- The nine selectors in increasing physical-register order. -/
def skip : Nat → Fin 244
  | 0 => oldStateRotation244 60
  | 1 => oldStateRotation244 44
  | 2 => oldStateRotation244 31
  | 3 => oldStateRotation244 56
  | 4 => oldStateRotation244 38
  | 5 => oldStateRotation244 40
  | 6 => oldStateRotation244 28
  | 7 => oldStateRotation244 64
  | _ => oldStateRotation244 69

def restoreZero : Fin 244 := oldStateRotation244 20
def markFirst : Fin 244 := oldStateRotation244 2
def markReturnOnes : Fin 244 := oldStateRotation244 4
def markReturnZero : Fin 244 := oldStateRotation244 6

theorem skip_one_facts : ∀ j : Fin 9,
    machineRotation244.transition (skip j.val) true = ⟨true, .right, some (skip j.val)⟩ := by decide +kernel

theorem skip_next_facts : ∀ j : Fin 8,
    machineRotation244.transition (skip (j.val + 1)) false =
      ⟨false, .right, some (skip j.val)⟩ := by decide +kernel

theorem row_skip_target :
    machineRotation244.transition (skip 0) false = ⟨false, .right, some restoreZero⟩ := by decide +kernel
theorem row_erase_one :
    machineRotation244.transition restoreZero true = ⟨false, .left, some markFirst⟩ := by decide +kernel
theorem row_mark_back :
    machineRotation244.transition markFirst false = ⟨false, .left, some markFirst⟩ := by decide +kernel
theorem row_mark_enter :
    machineRotation244.transition markFirst true = ⟨true, .left, some markReturnOnes⟩ := by decide +kernel
theorem row_mark_return_one :
    machineRotation244.transition markReturnOnes true =
      ⟨true, .left, some markReturnOnes⟩ := by decide +kernel
theorem row_mark_return_zero :
    machineRotation244.transition markReturnOnes false =
      ⟨false, .left, some markReturnZero⟩ := by decide +kernel
theorem row_mark_return_probe :
    machineRotation244.transition markReturnZero true =
      ⟨true, .left, some markReturnOnes⟩ := by decide +kernel

theorem skip_block (j : Nat) (hj : j < 8) (v : Nat) (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244 (zAt (skip (j + 1)) h l
      (false :: true :: (List.replicate v true ++ X))) (v + 2) =
      zAt (skip j) (h + ((v + 2 : Nat) : Int))
        (List.replicate (v + 1) true ++ false :: l) X := by
  rw [show v + 2 = (v + 1) + 1 by omega, zipRun_first,
    step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (skip_next_facts ⟨j, hj⟩)]
  change zipRun machineRotation244
    (zAt (skip j) (h + 1) (false :: l) (List.replicate (v + 1) true ++ X)) (v + 1) = _
  rw [scan_right _ _ _ (skip_one_facts ⟨j, by omega⟩)]
  congr 1
  omega

theorem skip_file (pre : List Nat) (m : Nat) (hm : pre.length + m < 9)
    (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244 (zAt (skip (pre.length + m)) h l (registerBits pre ++ X))
      (width pre) =
      zAt (skip m) (h + (width pre : Int)) ((registerBits pre).reverse ++ l) X := by
  induction pre generalizing h l with
  | nil => simp [registerBits, width, zipRun]
  | cons v pre ih =>
    simp only [width, registerBits, List.length_cons, List.cons_append, List.append_assoc]
    rw [show pre.length + 1 + m = (pre.length + m) + 1 by omega,
      zipRun_add, skip_block (pre.length + m) (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hm; omega), ih (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hm; omega)]
    simp only [List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_replicate,
      List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append, List.replicate_succ']
    congr 1
    omega

theorem mark_steps (v : Nat) (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244 (zAt (skip 0) h l (false :: true :: (List.replicate v true ++ X))) 3 =
      leftAt markFirst h l (false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ X)) := by
  rw [zipRun_first, step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ row_skip_target,
    zipRun_first, step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ row_erase_one, leftAt_cons,
    zipRun_first, step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ row_mark_back]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

def markExit (pre : List Nat) : Fin 244 :=
  if pre = [] then markFirst else markReturnZero

/-- Mark with an arbitrary terminal word, so both unpadded and explicitly
padded whole-file contracts are immediate clients. -/
theorem mark_word (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (hp : pre.length < 9)
    (h : Int) (l X : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244
      (zAt (skip pre.length) h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: true :: (List.replicate v true ++ X)))
      (2 * width pre + 3) =
      leftAt (markExit pre) h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ X)) := by
  rw [show 2 * width pre + 3 = width pre + (3 + width pre) by omega,
    zipRun_add]
  have forward := skip_file pre 0 (by simpa using hp) h l
    (false :: true :: (List.replicate v true ++ X))
  simp only [Nat.add_zero] at forward
  rw [forward, zipRun_add, mark_steps]
  by_cases he : pre = []
  · subst pre
    simp [width, registerBits, zipRun, markExit]
  · rw [RegisterMarkPerm252.return_end machineRotation244 markReturnOnes
      markReturnZero row_mark_return_one row_mark_return_zero
      row_mark_return_probe pre he markFirst row_mark_enter]
    simp only [markExit, if_neg he]
    congr 1
    omega

/-- Unpadded register-file contract, including every finite spare suffix. -/
theorem mark_zip (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat)
    (hp : pre.length < 9) (h : Int) (l : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244
      (zAt (skip pre.length) h l (registerBits (pre ++ v :: rest)))
      (2 * width pre + 3) =
      leftAt (markExit pre) h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: false ::
          (List.replicate v true ++ registerBits rest)) := by
  simpa only [registerBits_append, registerBits] using
    mark_word pre v hp h l (registerBits rest)

/-- Whole-tape Core semantics; no fixed false padding is required. -/
theorem mark {c : Config 244} (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat) (rest : List Nat)
    (hp : pre.length < 9) (h : Int) (l : List Bool)
    (hc : ZipRep c (zAt (skip pre.length) h l (registerBits (pre ++ v :: rest)))) :
    ZipRep (machineRotation244.runFrom c (2 * width pre + 3))
      (leftAt (markExit pre) h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: false ::
          (List.replicate v true ++ registerBits rest))) := by
  have hs := zipRun_sound machineRotation244 (2 * width pre + 3) hc
  rw [mark_zip pre v rest hp] at hs
  exact hs

/-- The same execution with an arbitrary explicitly represented terminal word. -/
theorem mark_with_suffix {c : Config 244} (pre : List Nat) (v : Nat)
    (hp : pre.length < 9) (h : Int) (l X : List Bool)
    (hc : ZipRep c (zAt (skip pre.length) h l
      (registerBits pre ++ false :: true :: (List.replicate v true ++ X)))) :
    ZipRep (machineRotation244.runFrom c (2 * width pre + 3))
      (leftAt (markExit pre) h l
        (registerBits pre ++ false :: false :: (List.replicate v true ++ X))) := by
  have hs := zipRun_sound machineRotation244 (2 * width pre + 3) hc
  rw [mark_word pre v hp] at hs
  exact hs

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.RegisterMarkRotation244

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.Rotation244KernelRows
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.ZipperRuns

/-!
Fresh Rotation244 port of Routing245Pulse.
Only machine/state/module identities and the explicit selector literals change.
All-register, complete-tape and positive-clock hypotheses are retained.
The original Mira-Cult/Jeff Ketchersid/Andrew James Wade and ProveIt lineage
remains attributed. This source is uncompiled at emission; coverage, exact
blank initialization and the final Combined243 calibration remain separate.
-/
namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Rotation244Pulse

open FiniteZipper ZipperRuns

private abbrev test := oldStateRotation244 75
private abbrev rollback := oldStateRotation244 112
private abbrev reverseCarry := oldStateRotation244 131

/-- The self-returning pulse reads the one written two transitions earlier. -/
theorem pulse_zero_zero (h : Int) (l r : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244 (zAt test h l (false :: false :: r)) 3 =
      leftAt reverseCarry h l (true :: true :: r) := by
  rw [zipRun_first,
    step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old75_false,
    zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old255_false,
    leftAt_cons, zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old255_true]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- The neighboring-one branch restores its initial zero before rollback. -/
theorem pulse_zero_one (h : Int) (l r : List Bool) :
    zipRun machineRotation244 (zAt test h l (false :: true :: r)) 3 =
      leftAt rollback h l (false :: true :: r) := by
  rw [zipRun_first,
    step_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old75_false,
    zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old255_true,
    leftAt_cons, zipRun_first,
    step_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ rowRotation244_old131_true]
  simp only [zipRun]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- Whole-tape Core transport for both local cases and arbitrary contexts. -/
theorem pulse_core {c : Config 244} (b : Bool) (h : Int) (l r : List Bool)
    (hc : ZipRep c (zAt test h l (false :: b :: r))) :
    ZipRep (machineRotation244.runFrom c 3)
      (leftAt (if b then rollback else reverseCarry) h l ((!b) :: true :: r)) := by
  have hs := zipRun_sound machineRotation244 3 hc
  cases b with
  | false => rw [pulse_zero_zero] at hs; exact hs
  | true => rw [pulse_zero_one] at hs; exact hs

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Rotation244Pulse

open SetTheory.BusyBeaver SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC
open Rotation244Simulation
open RegisterPath RegisterPathClean Permutation252Frame
open SymbolicRotation244 SiteRotation244 RuntimePerm252 RuntimeInstanceRotation244

#print axioms SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.RuntimeInstanceRotation244.covered_of_allSites
#print axioms SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.RuntimeInstanceRotation244.related_active
#print axioms SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.RuntimeInstanceRotation244.clean_suffix
#print axioms SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.RuntimeInstanceRotation244.source_from_walk
#print axioms SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.RuntimeInstanceRotation244.related_step

#print axioms SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.RuntimeInstanceRotation244.partialRun_eq_registerRun

#print axioms SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.RuntimeInstanceRotation244.allSites_halts_iff_binary

example (p : Program) (t : RMBisim.Tree) (ht : RMBisim.ptree p = t)
    (hs : SiteCoverage.allSites checkSite [] t = true) : Covered p := covered_of_allSites p t ht hs

example (p : Program) (a : Configuration) (c : Config 244) (h : Related p a c) :
    c.state ≠ none := related_active p a c h

example (p : Program) (P : List Bool) (e : Edge) (d : Nat)
    (hc : Clean p P) (hw : walk p (p.nnodes + 1) p.root P 0 = some (e, d)) :
    ∀ b ∈ P.drop d, b = false := clean_suffix p P e d hc hw

example (p : Program) (logical : Configuration) (binary : Config 244)
    (gap : Nat) (spares : List Nat) (e : Edge) (d : Nat)
    (hclean : Clean p logical.path) (hframe : DispatchFrame64 dispatch binary logical gap spares)
    (hw : walk p (p.nnodes + 1) p.root logical.path 0 = some (e, d))
    (hc : checkSite (consume logical.path d) e = true) :
    Represents (logical.path.length + gap - 64) (vregs logical.registers ++ spares)
      (start (consume logical.path d)) binary :=
  source_from_walk p logical binary gap spares e d hclean hframe hw hc

example (p : Program) (hcov : Covered p) (a b : Configuration) (c : Config 244)
    (hc : Related p a c) (hs : RegisterPath.step p a = some b) :
    ∃ k, 0 < k ∧ Related p b (machineRotation244.runFrom c k) := related_step p hcov a b c hc hs

example (p : Program) (hcov : Covered p) (a : Configuration)
    (hs : RegisterPath.step p a = none) : AtHalt p a := stopped_terminal p hcov a hs

example (p : Program) (hcov : Covered p) (a : Configuration) (c : Config 244)
    (hc : Related p a c) (hh : AtHalt p a) : BinaryHalts machineRotation244 c :=
  related_halt p hcov a c hc hh

example (p : Program) (hcov : Covered p) :
    PositiveSimulation machineRotation244 (RegisterPath.step p) (AtHalt p) (Related p) :=
  positive_simulation p hcov

example (p : Program) (N : Nat) (c : Configuration) :
    partialRun (RegisterPath.step p) N c = RegisterPath.run p N c := partialRun_eq_registerRun p N c

example (p : Program) (hcov : Covered p) (a : Configuration) (c : Config 244)
    (hc : Related p a c) : RegisterPath.Halts p a ↔ BinaryHalts machineRotation244 c :=
  register_halts_iff_binary p hcov a c hc

    (hs : SiteCoverage.allSites checkSite [] t = true) (a : Configuration) (c : Config 244)

  allSites_halts_iff_binary p t ht hs a c hc

  apply RuntimePerm252.prefix_run (positive_simulation p hcov) N a b c hc
  simpa only [partialRun_eq_registerRun] using hr

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.RuntimePerm252
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.InstructionRotation244
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.SiteCoverage

/-!
Fresh Rotation244 port of RuntimeInstanceRouting245.
Only machine/state/module identities and the explicit selector literals change.
All-register, complete-tape and positive-clock hypotheses are retained.
The original Mira-Cult/Jeff Ketchersid/Andrew James Wade and ProveIt lineage
remains attributed. This source is uncompiled at emission; coverage, exact
blank initialization and the final Combined243 calibration remain separate.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.RuntimeInstanceRotation244

open RegisterPath RegisterPathClean Permutation252Frame
open SymbolicRotation244 SiteRotation244 Rotation244Simulation
open RuntimePerm252

def Covered (p : Program) : Prop :=
  ∀ P, ∃ e d, walk p (p.nnodes + 1) p.root P 0 = some (e, d) ∧
    checkSite (consume P d) e = true

theorem covered_of_allSites (p : Program) (t : RMBisim.Tree)
    (ht : RMBisim.ptree p = t) (hs : SiteCoverage.allSites checkSite [] t = true) :
    Covered p := by
  intro P
  obtain ⟨e, d, hw⟩ := SiteCoverage.allSites_walk_total checkSite p t ht hs P
  exact ⟨e, d, hw, SiteCoverage.allSites_walk checkSite p t ht hs P e d hw⟩

def Related (p : Program) (logical : Configuration) (binary : Config 244) : Prop :=
  Clean p logical.path ∧ ∃ gap spares, spares ≠ [] ∧
    DispatchFrame64 dispatch binary logical gap spares

theorem related_active (p : Program) (logical : Configuration) (binary : Config 244)
    (hc : Related p logical binary) : binary.state ≠ none := by
  rcases hc with ⟨_, gap, spares, _, _, _, lp, rp, hz⟩
  have hs : binary.state = some dispatch := hz.1
  rw [hs]
  simp

theorem clean_suffix (p : Program) (P : List Bool) (e : Edge) (d : Nat)
    (hc : Clean p P) (hw : walk p (p.nnodes + 1) p.root P 0 = some (e, d)) :
    ∀ b ∈ P.drop d, b = false := by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem?.mp hb
  have hv : bit (P.drop d) i = b := by simp [bit, hi]
  exact hv.symm.trans ((bit_drop P d i).trans (hc e d hw (d + i) (by omega)))

theorem source_from_walk (p : Program) (logical : Configuration) (binary : Config 244)
    (gap : Nat) (spares : List Nat) (e : Edge) (d : Nat)
    (hclean : Clean p logical.path) (hframe : DispatchFrame64 dispatch binary logical gap spares)
    (hw : walk p (p.nnodes + 1) p.root logical.path 0 = some (e, d))
    (hcheck : checkSite (consume logical.path d) e = true) :
    Represents (logical.path.length + gap - 64) (vregs logical.registers ++ spares)
      (start (consume logical.path d)) binary := by
  apply source_represents logical binary gap spares (consume logical.path d) hframe
  · rw [consume_length]
  · simpa only [consume_length] using clean_suffix p logical.path e d hclean hw
  · exact checkSite_length _ _ hcheck

/-- A full logical step is implemented by a positive actual binary segment,
and the new logical state is clean regardless of its preceding path. -/
theorem related_step (p : Program) (hcov : Covered p)
    (logical next : Configuration) (binary : Config 244)
    (hc : Related p logical binary) (hs : RegisterPath.step p logical = some next) :
    ∃ k, 0 < k ∧ Related p next (machineRotation244.runFrom binary k) := by
  rcases hc with ⟨hclean, gap, spares, hspares, hframe⟩
  obtain ⟨e, d, hw, hcheck⟩ := hcov logical.path
  have he : execute e (consume logical.path d) logical.registers = some next := by
    simpa only [RegisterPath.step, hw] using hs
  obtain ⟨k, hk, gap', spares', hspares', hf⟩ := InstructionRotation244.execute_frame
    (consume logical.path d) e logical.registers spares
    (logical.path.length + gap - 64) binary next hcheck hframe.2.1 hspares
    (source_from_walk p logical binary gap spares e d hclean hframe hw hcheck) he
  exact ⟨k, hk, RegisterPathClean.step_clean p logical next hs, gap', spares', hspares', hf⟩

theorem stopped_terminal (p : Program) (hcov : Covered p) (logical : Configuration)
    (hs : RegisterPath.step p logical = none) : AtHalt p logical := by
  obtain ⟨e, d, hw, hcheck⟩ := hcov logical.path
  cases e with
  | node r => simp [checkSite, checkOperation] at hcheck
  | halt => exact ⟨d, hw⟩
  | inc r | brk r | cont r => simp [RegisterPath.step, hw, execute] at hs
  | decnz r => cases hv : logical.registers r <;> simp [RegisterPath.step, hw, execute, hv] at hs

theorem related_halt (p : Program) (hcov : Covered p)
    (logical : Configuration) (binary : Config 244)
    (hc : Related p logical binary) (hh : AtHalt p logical) : BinaryHalts machineRotation244 binary := by
  rcases hc with ⟨hclean, gap, spares, hspares, hframe⟩
  obtain ⟨d, hw⟩ := hh
  obtain ⟨e, d', hw', hcheck⟩ := hcov logical.path
  rw [hw] at hw'
  cases hw'
  obtain ⟨k, _, hk⟩ := InstructionRotation244.halt_frame (consume logical.path d)
    logical.registers spares (logical.path.length + gap - 64) binary hcheck hspares
    (source_from_walk p logical binary gap spares .halt d hclean hframe hw hcheck)
  exact ⟨k, hk⟩

theorem positive_simulation (p : Program) (hcov : Covered p) :
    PositiveSimulation machineRotation244 (RegisterPath.step p) (AtHalt p) (Related p) where
  active := related_active p
  step := related_step p hcov
  stopped := fun logical _ _ hs => stopped_terminal p hcov logical hs
  halt := related_halt p hcov

theorem partialRun_eq_registerRun (p : Program) (N : Nat) (c : Configuration) :
    partialRun (RegisterPath.step p) N c = RegisterPath.run p N c := by
  induction N generalizing c with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ N ih => cases hs : RegisterPath.step p c <;> simp [partialRun, RegisterPath.run, hs, ih]

theorem register_halts_iff_binary (p : Program) (hcov : Covered p)
    (logical : Configuration) (binary : Config 244) (hc : Related p logical binary) :
    RegisterPath.Halts p logical ↔ BinaryHalts machineRotation244 binary := by
  simpa only [AbstractHalts, RegisterPath.Halts, partialRun_eq_registerRun] using
    RuntimePerm252.halts_iff (positive_simulation p hcov) logical binary hc

theorem allSites_halts_iff_binary (p : Program) (t : RMBisim.Tree)
    (ht : RMBisim.ptree p = t) (hs : SiteCoverage.allSites checkSite [] t = true)
    (logical : Configuration) (binary : Config 244) (hc : Related p logical binary) :
    RegisterPath.Halts p logical ↔ BinaryHalts machineRotation244 binary :=
  register_halts_iff_binary p (covered_of_allSites p t ht hs) logical binary hc

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.RuntimeInstanceRotation244

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.SymbolicRotation244
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.Permutation252Frame

/-!
Fresh Rotation244 port of SiteRouting245.
Only machine/state/module identities and the explicit selector literals change.
All-register, complete-tape and positive-clock hypotheses are retained.
The original Mira-Cult/Jeff Ketchersid/Andrew James Wade and ProveIt lineage
remains attributed. This source is uncompiled at emission; coverage, exact
blank initialization and the final Combined243 calibration remain separate.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.SiteRotation244

open RegisterPath SymbolicRotation244

def dispatch : Fin 244 := dispatchRotation244
def minDistance : Nat := 64
def fuel : Nat := 4000

def physical (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9) : Reg :=
  ⟨Permutation252Frame.physOf r, Permutation252Frame.physOf_lt ⟨r, hr⟩⟩

def allOnes (P : List Bool) : Bool := P.all id

def start (Q : List Bool) : SConfig :=
  ⟨some dispatch, false, [.bit true],
    Q.map Segment.bit ++
      [.run false 1 (minDistance - Q.length), .bit true, .box (.plain .unchanged)]⟩

def target (P : List Bool) (overflow : Bool) (extra : Nat) (x : Box) : SConfig :=
  ⟨some dispatch, false, [.bit true],
    P.map Segment.bit ++
      [.run false 1 (minDistance + (if overflow then 1 else 0) + extra - P.length),
       .bit true, .box x]⟩

def runTo (br : Branch) (Q : List Bool) (wanted : SConfig) : Bool :=
  verifies fuel br (start Q) wanted

def runHalt (Q : List Bool) : Bool := verifiesHalt fuel none (start Q)

def checkOperation (Q : List Bool) : Edge → Bool
  | .node _ => false
  | .inc r =>
      if hr : r < 9 then
        runTo none Q (target (incPath Q) (allOnes Q) 0 (.plain (.increment (physical r hr))))
      else false
  | .decnz r =>
      if hr : r < 9 then
        runTo (some (physical r hr, true)) Q
          (target (breakPath 1 Q) (allOnes (stripPath false 1 Q)) 0 (.plain .unchanged)) &&
        runTo (some (physical r hr, false)) Q
          (target (incPath Q) (allOnes Q) 1 (.plain (.decrement (physical r hr))))
      else false
  | .brk k =>
      runTo none Q (target (breakPath k Q) (allOnes (stripPath false k Q)) 0 (.plain .unchanged))
  | .cont k => runTo none Q (target (continuePath k Q) false 0 (.plain .unchanged))
  | .halt => runHalt Q

/-- The distance bound is checked together with the operation, so every
accepted leaf can be used with the same arbitrary nonnegative gap parameter. -/
def checkSite (Q : List Bool) (e : Edge) : Bool :=
  decide (Q.length ≤ minDistance) && checkOperation Q e

theorem checkSite_length (Q : List Bool) (e : Edge) (h : checkSite Q e = true) :
    Q.length ≤ minDistance := by
  exact of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp h).1

theorem checkSite_operation (Q : List Bool) (e : Edge) (h : checkSite Q e = true) :
    checkOperation Q e = true := (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp h).2

theorem runTo_sound (br : Branch) (Q : List Bool) (wanted : SConfig)
    (he : runTo br Q wanted = true)
    (n : Nat) (vs : List Nat) (hv : Valid br vs) (c : Config 244)
    (hc : Represents n vs (start Q) c) :
    ∃ k : Nat, 0 < k ∧ Represents n vs wanted (machineRotation244.runFrom c k) :=
  verifies_sound fuel br (start Q) wanted he n vs hv c hc

theorem runHalt_sound (Q : List Bool) (he : runHalt Q = true)
    (n : Nat) (vs : List Nat) (hv : 10 ≤ vs.length) (c : Config 244)
    (hc : Represents n vs (start Q) c) :
    ∃ k : Nat, 0 < k ∧ (machineRotation244.runFrom c k).state = none :=
  verifiesHalt_sound fuel none (start Q) he n vs ⟨hv, trivial⟩ c hc

theorem check_inc (Q : List Bool) (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9)
    (h : checkSite Q (.inc r) = true) :
    runTo none Q (target (incPath Q) (allOnes Q) 0 (.plain (.increment (physical r hr)))) = true := by
  simpa only [checkOperation, dif_pos hr] using checkSite_operation Q (.inc r) h

theorem check_decnz (Q : List Bool) (r : Nat) (hr : r < 9)
    (h : checkSite Q (.decnz r) = true) :
    runTo (some (physical r hr, true)) Q
      (target (breakPath 1 Q) (allOnes (stripPath false 1 Q)) 0 (.plain .unchanged)) = true ∧
    runTo (some (physical r hr, false)) Q
      (target (incPath Q) (allOnes Q) 1 (.plain (.decrement (physical r hr)))) = true := by
  have hc := checkSite_operation Q (.decnz r) h
  simpa only [checkOperation, dif_pos hr, Bool.and_eq_true_iff] using hc

theorem check_break (Q : List Bool) (k : Nat)
    (h : checkSite Q (.brk k) = true) :
    runTo none Q (target (breakPath k Q) (allOnes (stripPath false k Q)) 0 (.plain .unchanged)) = true :=

theorem check_continue (Q : List Bool) (k : Nat)
    (h : checkSite Q (.cont k) = true) :
    runTo none Q (target (continuePath k Q) false 0 (.plain .unchanged)) = true :=
  checkSite_operation Q (.cont k) h

theorem check_halt (Q : List Bool) (h : checkSite Q .halt = true) : runHalt Q = true :=
  checkSite_operation Q .halt h

theorem check_inc_bound (Q : List Bool) (r : Nat) (h : checkSite Q (.inc r) = true) :
    r < 9 := by
  have hc := checkSite_operation Q (.inc r) h
  by_cases hr : r < 9
  · exact hr
  · simp only [checkOperation, dif_neg hr, Bool.false_eq_true] at hc

theorem check_decnz_bound (Q : List Bool) (r : Nat) (h : checkSite Q (.decnz r) = true) :
    r < 9 := by
  have hc := checkSite_operation Q (.decnz r) h
  by_cases hr : r < 9
  · exact hr
  · simp only [checkOperation, dif_neg hr, Bool.false_eq_true] at hc

theorem check_node_false (Q : List Bool) (r : Nat) : checkSite Q (.node r) = false := by
  simp only [checkSite, checkOperation, Bool.and_false]
